nodes.label: Native App Icon (Avantej)
nodes.description: Primary app icon for the Avantej Expo/React Native mobile app. Displays a stylized 3D glossy letter 'A' in blue gradient (light to dark blue) centered on a pale/light blue background. Design overlays include golden-ratio/composition guide circles and crosshair lines (dashed blue), consistent with Expo icon design tooling. The 'A' letterform has rounded tube-like arms meeting at a peak, no crossbar — an angular boomerang/chevron shape. Used as the launcher icon for the member-facing native app.
